description: JS port of flask_ssrf_image_proxy Diamond: (1) image-proxy endpoint validates hostname against allowlist, fetches via node http.request (no redirect-follow default), (2) add timeout + size cap + retry, (3) migrate to node-18 built-in fetch() for ergonomics and HTTP/2. fetch() follows 3xx by default — attacker's allowlisted server 302s to 169.254.169.254.
